title: Mark: what IRC PART and JMAP Chat destroy do in a fixed_membership one-to-one room (§7.1 vs room-policy-04 §5)
description: room-policy-04 §5: 'Ordinary users cannot leave or be removed, however a user can remove all its clients from the associated MLS group.' §7.1: PART leaves for real, every device leaves, only a new invite brings them back. In a fixed room nobody can re-invite (the user stays a participant, no adds) and the user can return alone (canAddOwnClient). Options: (A) PART/destroy remove all the user's clients (SelfRemove + own Removes, no list change), forget locally; the peer keeps writing into a room the user has no client in; open_direct rejoins by external Commit. (B) PART/destroy hide the room locally only (IRC: close the query; JMAP: forget_room without leaving, §7.9 tombstone), devices stay; the next message brings it back. (C) keep refusing (current). Recommendation: (B) for PART and destroy, with (A) as a separate explicit action later. Until decided Agent::leave refuses a fixed room. agent-frontends.md §7.29; bead mimid-qrbe.
